en.t: Me? I have only ever used love letters to boil milk and drink it.
What an honor. Go on, drink it.

units.source_text: 我暗暗想，這個人怎麼還不快點走？

en.t: I thought to myself, why does this person not hurry up and leave?

units.source_text: 說什麼寫信，明明是在那兒裝模作樣地胡亂寫著什麼磨蹭。

en.t: She said she was writing a letter, but she was obviously just putting on an act, scribbling nonsense to waste time.
Let me see what you wrote.

units.source_text: 話雖這樣說，其實我死也不想看。

en.t: Even though I said that, in truth I would rather die than look at it.

units.source_text: 她卻嬌聲低氣地嚷嚷道：「哎呀，不要啦，哎呀，不要啦。」

en.t: But she cried out in a coy, breathy voice, Oh no, please do not, oh no, please do not.

units.source_text: 她那喜上眉梢的神情實在不堪入目，讓我大為掃興。

en.t: The delighted look all over her face was truly unbearable to watch, and it completely spoiled my mood.

units.source_text: 於是，我想吩咐她做一些事。

en.t: So I thought I would give her some errand to do.

units.source_text: 「不好意思，你能不能去電車道路旁的藥店幫我買點卡爾莫欽[2]？

en.t: Sorry, but could you go to the pharmacy by the streetcar road and buy me some Calmotin?

units.source_text: 我真的快累死了，臉上發燙，睡不著覺，麻煩你了。

en.t: I am so exhausted, my face is burning, and I cannot sleep. Please do this for me.
